about:
![Pagle: a fishing addon for World of Warcraft: Forever. Your fishing story starts here.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/01-hero.jpg)

  [![License: GPL-3.0-or-later](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL--3.0--or--later-8a5a1c?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=3b2412)](https://github.com/timemir/pagle-addon/blob/main/LICENSE)
  ![World of Warcraft: Forever](https://img.shields.io/badge/WoW-Forever-c9962b?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=3b2412)
  ![Six addons, one download](https://img.shields.io/badge/addons-6_in_1_download-2f6b3f?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=3b2412)
  [![Send a Field report](https://img.shields.io/badge/Field_report-welcome-9c2f2f?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=3b2412)](https://github.com/timemir/pagle-addon/issues/new?template=field-report.yml)

  **Pagle** is a fishing addon for World of Warcraft: Forever, named after Nat Pagle and meant to be the only fishing addon you need.

  Progression and collection come first, with optional quality-of-life touches beside them.

  *It watches what you catch and rewards it. It never fishes for you.*

  [Fish Journal](#the-fish-journal) ·
  [Hunts](#hunts) ·
  [Wagers](#pagle-wagers) ·
  [Stats](#stats) ·
  [Tackle Board](#the-tackle-board) ·
  [Moments](#moments) ·
  [Curio Shop](#the-curio-shop) ·
  [Fishing key](#the-fishing-key) ·
  [How it works](#how-it-works) ·
  [Companion](#the-pagle-companion)

  ![35 Species, 53 zone crests, 16 Hunts, 24 Pagle Wagers, 3 Legends, 30 flies to tie](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/02-medallions.jpg)

Every Cast you make is written into one log, shared by every character on your account, and everything Pagle shows is read from it. Open any of it from Pagle's entry in the addon compartment by the minimap, or with `/pagle`.

## Get it

Pagle is one download of six addons. Unzip it so every folder lands in `Interface/AddOns`, then `/reload`.

> [!NOTE]
> Pagle runs on **World of Warcraft: Forever** only, and 1.0 is in English only.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/divider.png)

## The Fish Journal

![The Fish Journal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/ribbon-fish-journal.png)

The Ledger keeps your life as an angler in the Fish Journal, a leather-bound book of parchment pages. Every Catch earns XP toward your Angler Level, doubled by Fresh Water after a break from fishing, and at the top you can Prestige for an emblem and climb again. Each Species earns up to three stars, each zone a Zone Mastery rank from Visitor to Master, and the Junk Museum, Treasures and the Trophy Room fill in as you go.

![The Fish Journal's home: the waters you've fished, your Angler Level and what the Ledger holds](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/30-journal-home.jpg)

Fish you haven't caught stay nameless. A riddle sets the scene, and a plain hint is there when you'd rather just know. Legends, the named catches you won't land on an ordinary day, arrive with a splash and a title to sign the Journal with. Your longest of each Species is kept as well, from Tiddler to Monster.

![A Species page, and its ten colours](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/31-journal-species.jpg)

![The Trophy Room, and the Angler's bookplate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/32-journal-trophy.jpg)

**Browse the collection**: Prestige frames, Legends, zone crests and bindings

![Prestige frames, from the jetty to the stars](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/10-prestige-frames.jpg)

![Three Legends](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/13-legends.jpg)

![Fifty-three waters, a crest for each](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/11-zone-crests.jpg)

![Bindings for the Fish Journal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/12-bindings.jpg)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/divider.png)

## Hunts

![Hunts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/ribbon-hunts.png)

Hunts are the catches worth planning for: a fish that bites by night, in one season or during an event, or a catch that only counts under conditions of its own, such as a grouper by moonlight. The Hunts board, a leather notebook, lays them out on a timeline of what's biting now, what opens soon and what comes later. Each Hunt completes in bronze, some go on to silver and gold, and finishing a themed set earns its title. The board counts your Casts at each Hunt without pretending to know the odds, and the Hunts you pin follow you in a tracker under the minimap.

## Pagle Wagers

![Pagle Wagers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/ribbon-pagle-wagers.png)

Pagle Wagers are Hunts themed on one or two zones and put on the table for about three days at a time. Land every Hunt's first mark before the wager closes to settle it. Any number can be on at once, each one starts fresh and pays again, and every wager you settle climbs a ladder of titles.

![Pagle Wagers: four on the table, each with its own clock](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/40-hunts-wagers.jpg)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/divider.png)

## Stats

![Stats](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/ribbon-stats.png)

Stats keeps your own numbers in the Stats book: every Session, your lifetime totals, and what bites in each water you've fished. Your odds for each fish come only from your own Casts, and always say how many Casts they rest on. A Dry spell counts the Casts since you last caught something and says plainly when the wait is unusual. Every Cast is its own roll; nothing is owed. Watch up to three Dry spells on the live tracker. Stats shows numbers when you ask, and announces nothing.

![Lifetime: every Cast you've made](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/50-stats-lifetime.jpg)

![Every Session, and the waters you've fished](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/51-stats-sessions.jpg)

## The Tackle Board

![The Tackle Board](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/ribbon-tackle-board.png)

The Tackle Board is opt-in: a cork board where three Notices go up each day and an Expedition each week, such as "4 different Species in Feralas". Fish where you like, and they fill in as you go. They never expire, so a missed day banks rather than vanishes, and each one can be taken down, once a day, for a fresh one of another kind. Each day with a goal done keeps your Campfire burning, Kindling carries it through a day you couldn't make, and your longest Campfire is kept for good. Every goal done ties a new fly in your Fly Box.

![The Tackle Board, with its Campfire lit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/gif-tackle-board.gif)

![The Campfire: four weeks of board days, milestones and titles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/61-campfire.jpg)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/divider.png)

## Moments

![Moments](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/ribbon-moments.png)

When you earn something, Pagle says so in the moment. A toast rises and writes the fish's name out in ink while its stamps come down, a banner drops its seal for a new Angler Level, and a Legend gets the whole screen. The Interruption budget keeps it from talking over your fishing, Cozy mode holds everything for the end of the Session, and the Animations setting stills the motion if you'd rather it kept still. A Session that earned something ends with a summary card.

![A toast for a new Species](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/gif-toast.gif)

![A Zone Master banner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/gif-banner.gif)

![A Nod, a toast or a banner, and you choose how chatty](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/70-moments.jpg)

## The Curio Shop

![The Curio Shop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/ribbon-curio-shop.png)

Pagle Coins are paid for things achieved, never for sheer volume, and buy looks in the Curio Shop: toast styles, sound sets, Journal bindings, notebook covers and tracker frames. The stock never rotates, and nothing in it buys a title or a star.

![The Curio Shop: try a look on screen before you buy it](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/80-shop.jpg)

![Bindings and tracker frames](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/81-shop-more.jpg)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/divider.png)

## The Fishing Key

![The Fishing Key](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/ribbon-fishing-key.png)

QoL gives you a Fishing key. Bind it, and each press does the next sensible thing: put on your fishing set, apply a lure, cast, reel, or open a clam between Casts. A double right-click casts too. While you fish it can turn the music and ambience down so you hear the splash, and switch auto-loot on, and it puts your settings back when you stop. A small button shows what the next press will do, and a quiet line tells you when your lures run out. One press is one action, and QoL never acts on its own.

![One key for the whole cast, and your fishing clothes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/90-fishing-key.jpg)

## How It Works

![How It Works](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/ribbon-how-it-works.png)

![You fish, one Catch log records it, and every book reads from it. It never fishes for you.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/20-how-it-works.jpg)

Pagle is one download of six addons: Pagle itself and five Modules.

| Addon | What it is |
|---|---|
| `Pagle` | The core. It records every Catch into one log and owns the moments, the Curio Shop and the settings. |
| `Pagle_Ledger` | The Fish Journal. |
| `Pagle_Hunts` | Hunts and Pagle Wagers. |
| `Pagle_Stats` | Sessions, lifetime totals, odds and Dry spells. |
| `Pagle_TackleBoard` | Notices, Expeditions, the Campfire and the Fly Box. |
| `Pagle_QoL` | The Fishing key. |

Turn any Module off in the AddOns list and nothing of it loads. Pagle keeps recording your Catches either way, so a Module you turn back on catches up on everything it missed, in one card.

If Angleur or Fishing Buddy is loaded too, QoL asks which one should keep your fishing key, and turns the other off. The rest of Pagle carries on whichever you pick.

## The Pagle Companion

![The Pagle Companion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/ribbon-companion.png)

The Pagle Companion is an optional desktop app, outside the game. It uploads your Catch log to the Pagle website and brings the website back into the game: fresh Pagle Wagers from its schedule, in place of the addon's own rotation, and Published Anglers on player tooltips, with the ones you follow in your Fish Journal. Pagle works fully without it, and what it brings in shows nothing once it is a day old. Get it at [pagle.app/download](https://pagle.app/download).

![The Pagle Companion, and a Published Angler on a tooltip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/21-companion.jpg)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timemir/pagle-addon/main/docs/readme/divider.png)

## Good to know

- Pagle runs on World of Warcraft: Forever only.
- 1.0 is in English only.
- Seen something Pagle doesn't know yet, such as a fish in new waters or outside its usual hours? Type `/pagle report` and post the [Field report](https://github.com/timemir/pagle-addon/issues/new?template=field-report.yml) it gives you. It never names your characters.

## Working on Pagle

The six addons live under `addons/`, the generated content data under `data/` and the specs under `spec/`. The scripts run in WSL Ubuntu, on any x86_64 Linux, or natively on macOS (Apple silicon or Intel, with the Xcode Command Line Tools: `xcode-select --install`; no Homebrew needed, and macOS's own bash 3.2 runs everything but `scripts/package.sh`, whose packager needs bash 4.3).

```sh
scripts/setup.sh     # install the pinned toolchain into .tools/
scripts/check.sh     # the full gate: format, lint, types, tests
scripts/package.sh   # build the release zip the way the packager does (commit first)
```

A `git worktree` needs no toolchain of its own: with no `.tools/` in it, the scripts use the main checkout's (run `scripts/setup.sh` there once). To run a tool by hand from a worktree, use the main checkout's path, such as `<main checkout>/.tools/bin/python`. The specs and the generator's tests that run a tool themselves (`luac`, `lua`) find it the same way; with no toolchain anywhere they skip, saying where they looked, except in CI, where a missing tool fails them.

On Windows, `scripts/link-addons.ps1` junctions each `addons/*` folder into your `Interface\AddOns` folder, so edits go live after `/reload`; on macOS, `scripts/link-addons.sh` symlinks them (and with `--retail` makes them loadable in the retail client for UI checks, see [docs/agents/in-game-verification.md](https://github.com/timemir/pagle-addon/blob/main/docs/agents/in-game-verification.md#linking-the-addons)).

The project's vocabulary is in [CONTEXT.md](https://github.com/timemir/pagle-addon/blob/main/CONTEXT.md), its decisions in [docs/adr](https://github.com/timemir/pagle-addon/blob/main/docs/adr) and its release notes in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/timemir/pagle-addon/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

  [![Source on GitHub](docs/readme/link-source.png)](https://github.com/timemir/pagle-addon)

# Pagle

## 1.7.0 (2026-11-11)

Fish without a fishing set.

### Changed

- **No fishing set? The Fishing key takes your pole from your bags.** With the Fishing set left at None (the default), the Fishing key's first press with no pole in hand puts on the best fishing pole in your bags, instead of trying to cast without one. Pagle picks the pole with the biggest Fishing bonus you can use.
- **Swap gear works without a set too.** It puts the pole on, and with the pole in hand it puts your main-hand and off-hand weapons back in one press. Pagle remembers them for each character, even over a /reload or logout. When you walk away still holding the pole, the note reminds you of the key. No equipment set is made.
- The Swap gear key in Settings › Fishing is no longer greyed out with no fishing set chosen.

### TRANSLATORS

- Español: fmartingr

## 1.6.1 (2026-11-10)

Pagle speaks French.

### Added

- **Français.** All of Pagle's interface and Lore, in French, from Ikar-Rahl. It's machine-drafted, with a native speaker's proofread of the strings you see most, so corrections are welcome. A French game client gets it with Language on "Game default", and anyone can pick it in Settings › Units › Language. (#679)

## 1.6.0 (2026-11-10)

Morning news from your Anglers, and Hunts with your party.

### Added

- **The Morning Tide.** At login or /reload, a sign drops in with the best news about the Anglers you follow on the Pagle website: a Legend, a Prestige, the Ledger completed, a rare colour, Hunt gold, a Zone Master or a Monster record. Or it shows the first in your region to land a fish this month. When there's more, it says how many.
  - It hangs for about 8 seconds. Hover to hold it, right-click to send it up, left-click to read the news in the Fish Journal, or drag it somewhere else.
  - It never drops in combat, waits for any letter or the Field guide, stays away in Cozy mode, and shows only news you haven't seen.
  - Your first login with 1.6 shows nothing old. It needs an up-to-date Pagle Companion.
- **News in the Fish Journal.** The last 30 days of news about the Anglers you follow, plus your region's firsts this month, newest first, with new items marked. Open it from the sign, or from "News »" on the Following spread.
- **Settings › Announcements › The Morning Tide:** Show news at login, a switch for each kind of news, Region headlines, Mute the sign, and the sign's look.
- **Five sign looks in the Curio Shop.**
  - Scroll and Lantern cost 900 Coins, Astrolabe and Coral 3,000, Kraken 10,000. Try any with "Show on screen".
  - Wood stays free and the default.
  - Curio crates bought from 1.6 on can hold them.
- **Party Hunts.**
  - In a party (not a raid), while you fish the same zone, your groupmates' catches count toward your Hunts and Pagle Wagers, and yours count toward theirs. Both of you need Pagle 1.6 with Party Hunts on.
  - A tier reached this way says "party" on the Hunts board.
  - It pays exactly what your own catch would, never more.
  - On pagle.app it counts once your groupmate has uploaded their Catch log too.
- **"Completed for the party."** When a shared catch finishes a Hunt or settles a Pagle Wager for a groupmate, the rest of the party gets a small toast. It reads "Your catch" when the catch was yours.

### Changed

- **Party Hunts is opt-in.** The party letter now asks about it too. "Fish together" turns on Party Hunts, sharing your best catches, and your party's toasts and cheers. "Not now" asks again after a day; "No thanks" never asks again.
- **If you set a party switch yourself,** the letter takes that as your answer. Party Hunts stays off for you: turn it on in Settings › Announcements › Party › Party Hunts.
- **If you said "Fish together" in 1.5.3,** Party Hunts is already on.
- Pagle knows the areas the latest Forever patch added, and a Field report from Tirisfal Glades confirms what bites in Brightwater Lake and Stillwater Pond. Thanks, MrHedgeWoW! (#678, #680)

## 1.5.3 (2026-11-09)

Party sharing now asks first.

### Changed

- Party sharing now asks first, through a letter. Party toasts and cheers are off until you say yes. When Pagle sees a groupmate who also runs Pagle fishing in the same zone as you, a letter arrives: "Fish together" turns on sharing your best catches, your party's toasts and cheers; "Not now" asks again another day; "No thanks" never asks again. Every switch stays in Settings › Announcements › Party, and turning one on there yourself counts as your answer. (#655)
- If you already changed a party setting in 1.5.2, you keep your choice and the letter won't ask you. (#655)
- Pagle still says a quiet hello to your party so it can tell who runs Pagle. The hello carries no catches and no location. (#655)

### Fixed

- Changing Blizzard's own settings (such as Nameplates) after opening Pagle's settings no longer causes nameplate errors until a /reload.

### TRANSLATORS

- Español: fmartingr

## 1.5.2 (2026-11-08)

Cheer your party's best catches.

### Added

- Party toasts. In a party, when a groupmate who also runs Pagle catches a Legend, lands a rare or epic colour, sets a Monster-size record, reaches a Hunt's Gold tier, becomes a Zone Master, Prestiges or fills their Ledger to 100%, a small toast with their name shows in your toast column. It waits behind your own toasts, keeps to your interruption budget, waits out combat and stays quiet in Cozy mode. Not in a raid. (#640)
- Raise a mug. Each party toast has a mug on its right edge: click it to cheer your groupmate, and they see "Kukli raised a mug". When several of you cheer the same moment, it comes back as one line, such as "Kukli and Arwen raised a mug". (#640)
- Settings › Announcements › Party: "Share my moments with my party", "Show my party's moments" with a switch for each kind of moment, and "Cheers sounds". All are on to start. Only the moment itself is sent to your party (for a Zone Master, the zone you mastered), and nothing is saved or sent to pagle.app. (#640)

### TRANSLATORS

- Español: fmartingr

## 1.5.1 (2026-11-08)

Pick how the Pagle button looks, and how big it is.

### Added

- Settings › Pagle › "Minimap button style" picks the Pagle button's look: Classic, the round button you know; Ledger, a leather-bound book with a gilt P; or Bobber, a red and cream fishing bobber on night water. Ledger and Bobber light up when your mouse is over them and press in when you click. Classic stays the default, so nothing changes until you pick another.
- Settings › Pagle › "Minimap button size" makes the button smaller or bigger, from 80% to 150%, on the minimap's edge or wherever you've put it.

### TRANSLATORS

- Español: fmartingr

## 1.5.0 (2026-11-08)

Put the Pagle button anywhere.

### Added

- Settings › Pagle › "Detach from the minimap" takes the Pagle button off the minimap's edge. Drag it anywhere on your screen; it stays where you put it, even after a reload or a change of UI scale. Untick it to put the button back on the minimap. "Show the minimap icon" still hides it completely, and Pagle's menu stays in the game's add-on button either way. (#636)

### TRANSLATORS

- Español: fmartingr

## 1.4.0 (2026-11-07)

New leaderboards on pagle.app.

### Changed

- Pagle now tells pagle.app how many Tackle Board tasks and Pagle Wagers you've completed, so they get their own leaderboards, all-time and monthly. Your whole history counts, not just what you do from now on. Nothing changes in the game. (#633)

## 1.3.5 (2026-11-07)

Russian fits everywhere.

### Fixed
